caveats: Four female officers (Lauren Truscott, Valerie Carson, Kame Spencer, Judinna 'Jean' Gulpan) sued the City of Seattle/SPD alleging sexual harassment, grooming, and gender discrimination by then-Chief Adrian Diaz, Lt. John O'Neil, and others. Sources agree filed in 2024 but differ on month (Fox13 says April 2024, KOMO says July 2024). Settled for $2.6M (originally sought $5M) in early June 2026; city did not admit wrongdoing. No source mentions criminal charges, so criminal_status is 'unknown'.
